## Release Highlights

- **AULA S75 Pro:** lighting effects, per-key RGB, key mapping with the Fn layer, macros, the TFT screen and its clock. Over USB the keyboard is shown live, and effect, colour and brightness changes made with the knob or Fn keys are picked up.
- **AULA SC900 Pro:** DPI stages, polling rate up to 8000 Hz, sensor settings, buttons, macros and battery, with an on-screen display for the DPI button.
- **One app for your AULA devices:** profiles, backups, tray summary, low-battery alerts, the `aula` command line and 10 languages.

## Release Notes

### Keyboards
- Every hardware lighting effect with colour, brightness, speed and direction.
- Per-key lighting, key mapping on the base and Fn layers, macros with real timing.
- S75 Pro: picture or animated GIF upload to the TFT screen, clock sync, side light bar.
- Keyboard settings: Windows key, Alt+F4 and Alt+Tab lock, sleep time, key response.

### Mice
- Up to six DPI stages, polling rate, lift-off distance, motion sync, angle snapping, ripple control.
- Button remapping including rapid fire and macros, click debounce, sleep time, battery level.

### App
- Profiles per device with import and export; backup and restore of all settings.
- On-screen display with position, duration and multi-display options.
- Tray summary of all devices, low-battery alerts and battery statistics.
- Option to close the official AULA software and keep it from starting with Windows.
- Automatic updates.

## Download

| File | |
|---|---|
| `AULA-Toolkit-Setup-*.exe` | Installer with automatic updates (recommended) |
| `AULA-Toolkit-*-portable.exe` | Portable, no installation, no automatic updates |
| `AULA-Toolkit-*.AppImage` | Linux, any distribution, with automatic updates |
| `aula-toolkit_*_amd64.deb` | Linux, Debian / Ubuntu; installs the device permission rule |

## Known Issues

- Windows SmartScreen may show a warning because the app is not code-signed. Choose **More info → Run anyway**.
- The AULA F75 and SC900 versions other than the Pro have not been tested on hardware yet.
- Close the official AULA software while using AULA Toolkit.

Problems or ideas? [Open an issue](https://github.com/Livvaa/aula-toolkit/issues) or join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/u9FbaJGtCe).
